questions.question: Which international sports tribunal delivered the ruling that restored the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations title to Senegal?
questions.explanation: The Court of Arbitration for Sport decided in favour of the Senegalese Football Federation against CAF's earlier ruling.
questions.context: 2025 Africa Cup of Nations: In association football, the Court of Arbitration for Sport rules in favor of the Senegalese Football Federation and against the Confederation of African Football, and reverses the latter's controversial decision to overturn Senegal's 1–0 victory against Morocco in the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations final, thereby restoring Senegal as the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations champions.

questions.question: In which South American nation were 25 supermarket customers and staff held hostage following a botched security vehicle heist?
questions.explanation: Gunmen in Cartagena, Colombia took hostages inside a local shop when their attempt to rob an armoured vehicle failed.
questions.context: Armed men in Cartagena, Colombia take 25 people hostage in a supermarket after a failed armored-car robbery.

questions.question: In which Asian nation did industrial disputes cause operational stoppages across nearly 500 garment factories following minimum wage protests?
questions.explanation: Manufacturing at 481 factories was suspended in Bangladesh after widespread demonstrations broke out over worker pay.
questions.context: 2026 Bangladesh garment workers protests: Police fire tear gas and stun grenades to disperse protesting garment workers across Gazipur, Savar, and Ashulia, Bangladesh, as production halts at 481 factories amid minimum wage disputes.

questions.question: Former Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina announced her intention to return to the country on which national occasion?
questions.explanation: Sheikh Hasina stated she intends to travel back to Bangladesh on 16 December, coinciding with the nation's Victory Day.
questions.context: Aftermath of the July Uprising: Former Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina announces she plans to return to the country on December 16, coinciding with Victory Day.

questions.question: Security forces deployed over a hundred platoons across multiple districts in Bangladesh to safeguard industrial zones and key infrastructure following directives from which government department?
questions.explanation: The deployment of border guards across Bangladesh was ordered by the country's home ministry to maintain security around strategic assets.
questions.context: Aftermath of the July Uprising, 2026 Bangladesh garment workers protests: Border Guard Bangladesh deploys 101 platoons across Dhaka and seven other districts, including two battalions in Gopalganj, following instructions from the home ministry to increase surveillance at key installations and industrial areas.
